# 1. Load results

```{python}
#| label: load
import sys, json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Real LaTeX (Computer Modern), consistent with simulate.qmd / test8_plot.qmd
plt.rcParams.update({
    "text.usetex":     True,
    "font.family":     "serif",
    "font.size":       9,
    "axes.titlesize":  10,
    "axes.labelsize":  10,
    "legend.fontsize": 8,
    "text.latex.preamble": r"\usepackage{amsmath}\usepackage{amssymb}",
})

# sweep_runner gives us SimConfig.filename_stem() so we can locate every trace csv
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("./lib")))
import sweep_runner as sr

OUT       = Path("./sweep/runs/stage0a_NA_convergence")
results_csv = OUT / "results.csv"
decision_txt = OUT / "decision.txt"
traces_dir   = OUT / "traces"

assert results_csv.exists(), f"Run `python bin/run_stage0a.py` first — {results_csv} not found."
df = pd.read_csv(results_csv).sort_values("harmonics").reset_index(drop=True)

cols = ["harmonics", "Rdet_chi2_red", "Rdet_RMSE",
        "Rdet_pearson_r", "R_chi2_red", "runtime_s"]
df[cols].round(4)
```

# 2. Convergence plot

```{python}
#| label: figure

# Centre-of-cube parameters (must match bin/run_stage0a.py)
CENTRE = dict(
    period_um        = 12.9,
    A_um             = 1.5,
    t_oxide_um       = 0.30,
    oxide_dispersion = "HS_caliente",
    theta_deg        = 30.0,
    phi_sim_deg      = 89.0,
    slices           = 50,
    beta_deg         = 2.0,
    wavelengths_um   = np.arange(3.0, 25.0, 0.25),
)

NA_grid = sorted(df["harmonics"].astype(int).tolist())
NA_REF  = max(NA_grid)
ref_stem = sr.SimConfig(harmonics=NA_REF, **CENTRE).filename_stem()
df_ref   = pd.read_csv(traces_dir / ref_stem / f"AVG_{ref_stem}.csv")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4.5), constrained_layout=True)

cmap = plt.cm.viridis
deltas = []
for i, NA in enumerate(NA_grid):
    stem = sr.SimConfig(harmonics=NA, **CENTRE).filename_stem()
    avg = pd.read_csv(traces_dir / stem / f"AVG_{stem}.csv")
    color = cmap(i / max(len(NA_grid) - 1, 1))
    ax[0].plot(avg["x"], avg["R_det"], lw=1.3, color=color, label=rf"$\mathrm{{NA}}={NA}$")
    deltas.append(float(np.max(np.abs(avg["R_det"] - df_ref["R_det"]))))

ax[0].set_xlabel(r"$\lambda \;[\mu\mathrm{m}]$")
ax[0].set_ylabel(r"$\langle R_{\mathrm{det}} \rangle_{\mathrm{sim}}\,(\beta=2^{\circ})$")
ax[0].set_title(rf"$R_{{\mathrm{{det}}}}(\lambda)$ vs harmonics NA")
ax[0].legend(loc="lower right", framealpha=0.85)
ax[0].grid(True, alpha=0.4)

ax[1].plot(NA_grid, deltas, "ko-", lw=1.5, ms=6)
ax[1].axhline(0.01, color="red", ls="--", lw=1.2, label=r"$\sigma_{\mathrm{floor}}=0.01$")
ax[1].set_yscale("log")
ax[1].set_xlabel(r"$\mathrm{NA}$")
ax[1].set_ylabel(rf"$\max_\lambda \, |R_{{\mathrm{{det}}}}(\mathrm{{NA}}) - R_{{\mathrm{{det}}}}({NA_REF})|$")
ax[1].set_title(rf"Convergence vs $\mathrm{{NA}}_{{\max}} = {NA_REF}$")
ax[1].legend()
ax[1].grid(True, alpha=0.4, which="both")
plt.show()
```

# 4. What this locks in

The chosen NA above feeds straight into [docs/SWEEP_PLAN.md](../../design/SWEEP_PLAN.md)
"Stage 0a", and is the value every subsequent stage script and report uses.
After this, the next blocker is the **φ-convention sanity check** (Stage 0b)
— see [docs/DISTANCE.md §6](../../design/DISTANCE.md) and [docs/DISTANCE.md §9](../../design/DISTANCE.md).
